description: Na₅Y₄(SiO₄)₄F crystallizes in the tetragonal I̅4 space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.37-2.88 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted q6 geometry to eight O and two equivalent F atoms. There are four shorter (2.59 Å) and four longer (2.82 Å) Na-O bond lengths. Both Na-F bond lengths are 2.73 Å. Y is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to seven O and one F atom. There are a spread of Y-O bond distances ranging from 2.29-2.54 Å. The Y-F bond length is 2.53 Å. Si is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four O atoms. There is one shorter (1.64 Å) and three longer (1.65 Å) Si-O bond lengths. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four equivalent Na, one Y, and one Si atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two Na, two equivalent Y, and one Si atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to two Na, two equivalent Y, and one Si atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, two equivalent Y, and one Si atom. F is bonded to two equivalent Na and four equivalent Y atoms to form corner-sharing FNa₂Y₄ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted.
